recommended_description: Recommended mode configures the highest-ranked route that is available and allowed by policy: certified routes first, then input-method-v2 (when libei key pass-through is available), then IBus; it never automatically selects evdev or another globally observing path.

required_permissions: Allow WayExpand to add and select its IBus source in GNOME input settings
setup_instructions: Run wayexpand setup --apply to preserve existing sources and add WayExpand
Verify WayExpand appears in GNOME's input-source menu; reselect it after changing input sources if needed
desktop_profiles.last_certification_result: Not certified; no accepted GNOME physical-desktop evidence

required_permissions: IBus engine selection for the recommended route
Explicit consent and raw-input access for evdev compatibility mode
RemoteDesktop portal consent for libei injection when requested
setup_instructions: Run wayexpand backend test --capture and --injection separately before evaluating evdev+libei
known_limitations: Multi-layout EIS active-group discovery may be unavailable
desktop_profiles.last_certification_result: Not certified; preserved KWin tests are not current physical-input certification

required_permissions: Compositor support and activation for input-method-v2
Explicit raw-input authorization for evdev fallback
setup_instructions: Use input-method-v2 only when the live probe and organization policy allow it
Do not enable evdev when the active layout cannot be determined
known_limitations: Sway evdev does not report the effective keyboard XKB layout
Input-method-v2 application behavior is not certified
desktop_profiles.last_certification_result: Not certified; no accepted Sway physical-desktop evidence

required_permissions: Compositor support and activation for input-method-v2
Explicit raw-input authorization for evdev fallback
setup_instructions: Use the live capability and policy recommendation
Run real-client tests after compositor upgrades
known_limitations: Input-method-v2 application behavior is not certified
evdev fallback does not detect sensitive fields
desktop_profiles.last_certification_result: Not certified; no accepted Hyprland physical-desktop evidence

routes.label: IBus
routes.setup_detail: toolkit-aware committed text; capture stays off until the field reports a non-sensitive content type, and replacements require matching surrounding text; no raw keyboard access

routes.label: Maximum compatibility
routes.setup_detail: explicit evdev compatibility fallback with libei output; observes global keyboard input and has no password-field awareness

routes.label: Evdev + wlroots
routes.setup_detail: explicit evdev compatibility fallback with wlroots virtual-keyboard output; observes global keyboard input and has no password-field awareness

routes.label: Input Method v2
routes.setup_detail: exclusive text capture; unsupported-key pass-through and compositor behavior require certification
